d:
Long, flowing rust-orange hair with a messy texture, featuring thick, jagged bangs and a side-swept parting. Large, expressive almond-shaped eyes of a deep mahogany brown, paired with a youthful, teenage face. A slender, lithe build wearing a dark navy blue sleeveless jumper dress over a short-sleeved white collared blouse, accented by a small red ribbon bow at the chest, white crew socks with red stripes at the top, and black flat Mary Jane shoes.

BODY COLOR: fair peach
HANDS: five-fingered hands
